senses.gloss: m. (אגג, v. אֵגֶה = h. חוֹגֵג q. v.) cleft, fissure. א׳ דמיא cataract, water-falls (issuing from a fissure).
units: Lam. R. to I, 17 (play on ḥogeg ibid.
<cite ref="Psalms 42:5">Ps. XLII, 5</cite>) <he>כהדין א׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. like the cataract that rests neither &c. [Ed. <cite ref="C01184"><he>געגעא</he></cite>].
